name: Calculate Volume Weight
content:
Calculate Volume Weight

Term Value weight and dimensional weight was introduced in shipping market as soon as air transportation services start developing. Airway Companies In order to reduce cost or gain more profit start charging value weight every customer would be this Gzavnili LLC or bigger companies like UPS, FedEx or DHL.

Value weight is a calculation of a theoretical weight of a package. If the package is below this minimum density, then the actual weight is irrelevant as the freight carrier will charge for the volume of the package as if it were of the chosen density (what the package would weigh at the minimum density).

Oversized dimension is charged when shipments length and girth exceeds a standard dimensions.

There are two types of oversized packages. A package is considered “Oversize 1” when it exceeds dimensions 48” x 40 “ x 41”. If package is more then this dimensions then on top of volume weight or actual weight customer pay extra $ 45.00 per shipment.

A package considered “Oversize 2” when it exceeds dimensions 119” x 119” x 65”. In this case, shipping price and time frames is changes. For more information Please contact us.

  • For Sentimeters
  • For inches

Calculating in Sentimeters:

Volume Weight calculated as follows: Length X Wide X Height / 6000

Length (sm)   Wide (sm)   Hight (sm)   Weight (kg)
X X = KG

Calculating in Inches:

Volume Weight calculated as follows: Length X Wide X Height / 366

Length (inch)   Wide (inch)   Hight (inch)   Weight (kg)
X X = KG
